title: Chemistry: Atoms to Reactions
description: Meet the particles, build a bond and keep every atom. Predict how much a reaction can make.
audience: An adult comfortable with arithmetic, fractions and simple ratios. Build a foundation in particles, bonding and chemical quantities.
